svg.text: What a nurse can actually quote when a patient is turned away.

g.text: No discrimination in any form (s.4)
Access to public places and buildings (s.6)
Free education in a public school (s.18)
Free general medical care in a
public health facility (s.31)
Rehabilitation in the person's own
community wherever possible (s.15)
Employers may not refuse work on the
ground of disability alone, and get a
tax rebate for employing (s.10)
Health Ministry with District Assemblies
runs district health assessment
centres for early detection (s.35)
Breach is an offence: fine up to 50
penalty units, or up to 3 months (s.8)
The National Council on Persons with Disability sits under the Ministry of Gender, Children
and Social Protection. Complaints go there, and District Assemblies hold the local duty.

svg.text: THE GAP BETWEEN THE LAW AND THE RAMP

g.text: A right written in a statute is not a ramp built at a clinic door. The Act gives a nurse the
language for advocacy, not an automatic remedy, and most breaches are never prosecuted.
Quote the section, put the barrier in writing, and take it to someone with a budget.
